name: BREAK: Question Understanding Benchmark
description: BREAK is a question understanding benchmark comprising 83,978 questions across 10 diverse conversational and semantic parsing datasets. Questions are annotated with Question Decomposition Meaning Representation (QDMR), expressing complex questions as sequences of simpler computation steps.

license.name: MIT License (Annotations) / Inherited Source Benchmark Terms
license.notes: Code and QDMR annotations released under MIT License by Allen Institute for AI and Tel Aviv University. Sourced from 10 existing QA datasets including HotpotQA, DROP, and Spider.

verification.notes: Verified against TACL 2020 publication (DOI: 10.1162/tacl_a_00309) and official GitHub repository (allenai/Break). 83,978 total annotated questions partitioned across standard QDMR (60,150) and high-level QDMR (23,828).
